sections.name: File setup, GET
sections.title: Imports and saved results handler
sections.what: Loads the tools and returns saved verification results for a case, or a not-found response.
sections.why: Likely reason: separates reading saved results from running new checks.
sections.watch_out: No catch around the service call, so unexpected failures are not handled here.

summary: Web address that lists saved verification results for a case.
purpose: Lets the page show checks that have already been run.
why: Likely reason: reading saved results should not rerun the checks.
how: Checks that the case exists, returns a 404 if not, and otherwise returns the saved verification list.
outputs: JSON with a data list, or a 404 with code CASE_NOT_FOUND.
risks: Unexpected errors from the service are not caught.
debug: An empty list means verification has not been run yet. Run the verify address first.
